Opened genuine MS Teams test 132124168 from its plotted aggregate; inspected the individual detailed-sample table, its toolbar and all eleven column-header controls.

results.reason: The individual MS Teams detailed-sample table has sortable headers, pagination and CSV export, but no sample or column filtering control. Header hover and inspection of all eleven headers exposed sorting only. The layer catalogue filter and cluster-list search are different views and do not satisfy this requirement.

results.criterion: When details for a selected result fail to load, the dialog does not display stale or misleading data.

coverageChecks.assertion: SIMULATED UI STATE: a failed detail read displays an error without stale previous-record details, then recovers after the browser-only failure is removed.

steps_taken: Started independently at the launcher; opened GIS and captured the genuine populated detail baseline for test 132124168.
Installed one browser-only exact-URL, GET-only handler returning HTTP 503 for the different visible cluster member 131879769. Selected that member through its normal row.
Verified one intercepted request, the explicit error alert and Retry, and absence of visible detail/sample tables; captured and inspected the error state.
Removed the exact owned handler, pressed Retry, observed genuine HTTP 200 and the distinct 4 August record with 455 samples, then captured and inspected recovery.

Verified the handler was absent. Closed only the three test-created MS Teams tabs, removed only the added Automobile layer, and restored the pre-existing Surveyor layer, cluster tab, empty catalogue search and map camera to approximately -0.579309 / 51.432076 at zoom 18 (initial latitude 51.432074). No backend or authentication state was changed.
results.reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: a browser-only HTTP 503 was injected for GET /api/platform/automobile/ms-teams-call/tests/131879769 after genuine test 132124168 had loaded. The target showed “Unable to load this MS Teams Call test” and Retry with no visible summary, charts or sample table from the previous test. Removed the exact handler; Retry returned genuine HTTP 200 and loaded test 131879769 with 455 samples. This proves client error presentation and recovery, not a naturally occurring backend failure.
